column1: # Shared cron-expression fixtures for gitbackup's schedule validator.
# Run by both implementations: package/gitbackup/files/usr/share/gitbackup/schedule.sh's
# gb_cron_valid (tests/run.sh, "schedule.sh: gb_cron_valid fixtures") and the
# JS validator that ships in htdocs/.../view/gitbackup (ticket 12) -- a
# disagreement between the two on any row here is a red CI, not a note for
# later (spec, "Schedule" section: the two validators share this file and a
# mismatch between them must fail CI).
# Format: tab-separated, two columns, one case per line.
#   <expr>
# Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are ignored. <expr> itself never
# contains a literal tab or a leading/trailing space, so a plain split on
# the first tab is enough -- no quoting rules to agree on between sh and JS.
# Field bounds enforced (measured on the OpenWrt 25.12.4 stand by running
# busybox crond against fixture crontabs and reading its own parse
# errors/debug dump): minute 0-59, hour 0-23, day-of-month 1-31, month 1-12,
# day-of-week 0-6 (NOT 0-7 -- busybox has no Sunday-as-7 alias).
# -- baseline valid forms --
# -- @-macros: busybox 25.12 has no CONFIG_FEATURE_CROND_SPECIAL_TIMES table --
@daily
@hourly
@reboot
@weekly
# -- field count --
# (a genuinely empty <expr> is not a case here -- it is indistinguishable
# from a blank separator line in this format; "* * * *" already exercises
# the wrong-field-count path a reader would otherwise reach for.)
# -- out-of-range single values (busybox itself gives "parse error" on each) --
# -- ranges --
# -- steps --
# -- lists --
# -- garbage --
abc * * * *
0 3 * * mon
